messages:
Nora: dropped a narrow-surface mock for the batch vectors toolbar. main goal: reduce accidental exports and clarify copy. figma: https://figma.redwood/batch-mini-preview :eyes:
Felix: visually this helps. immediate ask: can we make Preview the primary action and tuck Export into the kebab? users keep hitting Export when they meant Preview
Yasmin: +1. also we should show a small filesize estimate before enqueueing. That will cut down on support tickets when large exports run overnight
Devon: backend note: we can return a cheap estimate for selected rows (approx bytes) and add a boolean "low_priority" for export jobs. That buys time until we have a proper quota system
Priya (a11y): accessibility items: - keyboard order must match visual priority (Preview first). - modal/panel open should announce sample header and approximate size via aria-live. - don't rely on color for relevance; include an icon + "Relevance: High/Med/Low" text for screen readers
Nora: copy thoughts: current "Export vectors" -> change to "Export selected vectors (.csv)". Modal header: "Export selected vectors". CTA: "Export (~1.2 MB)". Toast: "Your export is queued. We'll email a download link when ready."
Felix: UX: show a tiny CSV header sample in the export panel, e.g. ```id,vector_0,vector_1,...,metadata```. Also a toggle "Include metadata" so users know what grows the file size
Yasmin: when selection > 5k rows, surface a warning inline: "You're exporting 5,400 rows (~120 MB). This can take several minutes. Continue?" with Cancel + Continue buttons. That should deter accidental large exports
Devon: implemented plan: fast estimate -> surface size -> if confirmed, enqueue low_priority job -> emit progress events -> store artifact and send signed link. ETA: PR in 2 sprints for infra changes, UI small changes this sprint
export-bot: note: exports by default will be low-priority. Admins can mark a job as high-priority from Exports page (audit logged)
Priya (a11y): test cases: NVDA/VoiceOver readout of panel open, focus landing on first control, aria-describedby linking to size + sample header, and focus return on close. Also ensure keyboard-only users can open kebab -> Export -> confirm without mouse
Nora: ok consensus: - Preview primary - Export in overflow/panel - show sample CSV header + filesize estimate - include "Include metadata" toggle - warning when >5k rows - SR announcements and keyboard order fix. I'll update the Figma and the copy doc and tag everyone when done :slightly_smiling_face:
Felix: I'll mock the small inline panel variant and an overflow-menu variant so we can test both in staging
Yasmin: adding a tiny lint item: change primary button color at 12px to meet AA contrast or increase padding/text size
Devon: noted. We'll also add an opt-in email and in-app notification copy sample: "Your vectors export is ready: Download CSV (link)"
Nora: thanks team 44D closing thread for now
